muratceme-qlik-script-studio-qlik-load-s.description: Generates Qlik Sense / QlikView load scripts (LOAD, QVD, Excel, CSV, SQL, inline, join, keep, concatenate, ApplyMap, GROUP BY, WHERE, calculated fields, master calendar, STORE, synthetic key and circular reference fixes) from a user's table and field definitions, using the same deterministic rules as the Qlik Script Studio app.
